result.title: OrionMoE-v1.0: A Mixture-of-Experts Foundation Model for Tabular In-Context Learning
result.summary: Tabular foundation models enable in-context learning by predicting unseen observations from a labeled support table without task-specific parameter updates. Despite recent advances, most existing approaches rely on dense architectures that apply the same transformations across features and datasets. We introduce OrionMoE-Small, a compact tabular foundation model that combines distribution-aware representations with dataset-conditioned sparse mixture-of-experts computation. Built on a dual-axis Transformer architecture, OrionMoE-Small selectively activates experts along the feature axis, with routing decisions informed by both individual feature representations and the broader dataset context. This design enables adaptive allocation of computation across heterogeneous tabular problems while retaining a shared computational pathway across tasks. OrionMoE-Small is pretrained entirely on synthetic classification tasks generated from a structured causal prior and performs downstream prediction without gradient-based adaptation. Experiments across multiple tabular benchmarks demonstrate competitive performance against substantially larger foundation models, with particularly strong results on small-context and high-dimensional datasets. Further analysis reveals favorable relative performance under class imbalance and highlights the importance of feature composition.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 OrionMoE-Small，一个面向表格上下文学习的紧凑基础模型：在双轴 Transformer 上沿特征轴做稀疏 MoE，路由同时依据单个特征表示与数据集上下文，并以结构化因果先验生成的合成分类任务预训练，下游预测不做梯度适配。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「数据集条件化稀疏路由」是自适应分配计算的一种实现，可能为 LVR 中动态计算与逐特征/逐位置状态路由提供可供核查的线索；但该工作面向表格数据，不涉及视觉证据或 latent 推理状态，迁移属推测。
